registry_settings_measured_now.label: Inflation (money wage un-pinned)
registry_settings_measured_now.note: `consistent_pricing` plus wage_spec=growth: the money wage grows, so the price level does. In every other arm `w` is never assigned and holds its workbook value for all 100 periods, which freezes the price of production p_t (homogeneous of degree one in (p_t, w)) and hence the price level. The form is Godley & Lavoie (2007, ch. 9) -- a markup on unit costs with the profit rate a residual; NO uniform profit rate is imposed, mu stays as calibrated at t = 1, and the numeraire question is not reopened. wage_drift = 0.03 is autonomous money-wage growth of 3% per period, set ABOVE the bill rate r_b = r_star + mu_b = 2.159% (Z1) so that nominal growth exceeds it and the debt ratio recursion coefficient (1+r_b)/(1+g) falls below one; it is a chosen magnitude, not an estimated one. The conflict channel (wage_omega3, wage_psi0, wage_psi1) is written in model/code/wage_block_2026.R and left at 0 here: wired, not exercised. NAMED `current_revised_inflation` UNTIL 2026-09-23. Renamed because the compound name grew with every edit, and because `current_revised` is now a pointer at the frontier rather than a configuration; the frontier since 2026-09-25 is `consistent_pricing`, not this arm.

registry_settings_measured_now.label: Sraffian (uniform profit rate)
registry_settings_measured_now.note: `adjudicated` plus price_spec=production: the price of production on the flow capital base A+D, p = (1+r)p(A+D) + l with r = pi*R (pi the profit share, R = 1/lambda_max(A+D) - 1), wages ex post, standard-commodity numeraire. The sectoral markup mu and the t=1 unity calibration are DISCARDED by design -- the uniform rate replaces the 108 markups. This is the uniform-r closure, NOT the markup/real-competition pricing, and it does NOT adopt Isikara-Mokre's advanced-wage convention. wage_spec=numeraire (fixed money wage), and one wage per region (the employment-weighted mean of the 54 sectoral wages, Task 4) is applied under price_spec=production; Task 8 decides whether wage_spec=growth (money-wage inflation) is wanted. The regional profit share (leeds.regional_profit) is the I-M international variant, ON by default -- options(leeds.regional_profit=FALSE) recovers the single-global-share closure. model/code/sraffian_block_2026.R; qmd/plans/2026-09-23-sraffian-arm-and-stable-baseline.md Task 3.
